name: getpeppr-docs-checks
description: Toolchain that compiles, parses or RUNS every published example in this repository. It never calls the getpeppr API and consumes no secret; `check:export` executes the export examples against a local replay of the gateway on 127.0.0.1, and the only outbound request any check makes is an anonymous GET of the public OpenAPI spec.

scripts.check: npm run check:examples && npm run check:snippets && npm run check:python && npm run check:shell && npm run check:postman && npm run check:routes && npm run check:export
